# plotly.js (basic bundle)

`plotly-basic-2.35.2.min.js` — plotly.js v2.35.2, "basic" partial bundle (scatter,
bar, pie; zoom, pan, range slider, unified hover). MIT licence, see `LICENSE.txt`.

Served by TestLab itself so the DCS plots work on an internal network without
Internet access; no page loads anything from a CDN.

Source: https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-basic-2.35.2.min.js
SHA-256: 138c2e81014b979dc00867a93da55b7605a17495ee78dd7afb433b7f021dfcfa

To update: download the new `plotly-basic-<version>.min.js`, replace the file,
update the `<script>` path in `execution/templates/execution/dcs_detail.html`,
the version and hash above, and check the DCS plot page.
